scope: Bounded synthetic Northstar population, offline source SQL and unbound model packets only.

population.lineage: Current manifest pins profile, seed, structural generator revision, generator implementation SHA-256, identity schema and complete shared-map/table logical and file hashes. TQ-003 Catalog.fixture_population validates actual files independently of clocks.
population.bindings: Unresolved until actual approved created-ID receipts; no prior target or approval is adopted.
population.clocks: Eight distinct source data watermarks; source model revision is separate; ontology/context clocks remain NOT_RUN.

sourcePolicy.intervals: Half-open UTC validity; reject subminute incident/contract/map boundaries before publishing a manifest.
sourcePolicy.creditIdentity: One Finance posting per account/service-month; credit_key = YYYYMM(service_month) * 1000000 + account_key within this bounded revision.
sourcePolicy.settlement: Threshold independently per service-month, then one contract-month cap. Source-owned signed eligible minus applied; no clamp. Negative Enterprise postings are invalid, distinct from signed Finance charge reversals.
sourcePolicy.absence: Absent Applied Credits row is null in display, explicit zero row is zero; an existing null amount is unknown, not absence. Source SLA outage/eligible/applied values and service breach are null when effective-period mapping is incomplete. coverage_complete and service expected_minutes are diagnostic facts, not new measures. The provider checks actual filtered raw source rows before aggregation and marks any selected unknown PARTIAL. Known unselected gaps do not contaminate a covered selection; missing mapping and empty cohort are not measured zero impact.
sourcePolicy.attribution: Incident selection chooses contracts only; Enterprise amounts are whole-month settlements, not incident-caused loss. Finance Posted Credits has no contract key and is not netted against Enterprise credits.
sourcePolicy.financeGrain: Deduplicate account-period identities before Finance lookup; multi-contract/service membership cannot fan out account-month totals.
sourcePolicy.nonadditive: Query ratios, distinct counts, medians and snapshots at final supported grain; no recombination of batches.
sourcePolicy.digitalCommerce: Sessions, orders, fulfilled units and observed inventory snapshots are separate grains. Booked device revenue is not recognized service revenue. Anonymous sessions stay unresolved.
sourcePolicy.growth: Seeded synthetic randomized campaign has eligible treatment and control evidence at aggregate campaign grain. Observed retention motifs do not prove causal uplift; no per-market or individual prediction is claimed.

sourceCases.variation: Positive, zero and negative contribution margins plus zero recognized service revenue.
Account 1 has contracts 1/2; contract 1 has services 1/2; contract 3 has services 4/5.
Contract 1 capped/absent, 2 uncapped/explicit zero, 3 partial, 4 full, 5 below threshold; 6 cross-month partial.
Service 1 moves site 1 to site 3 at July 16 12:00 UTC, during overlapping incidents.
Incident 6 spans June 30 23:00 through July 1 02:00 UTC. Period selection clips the interval and reads each selected period's settlement.
Incident 7 overlaps the known service 10 mapping gap. Selecting it alone blocks downstream financial queries.
Service 11 has continuous site 7 mapping and no incident overlap; this is distinct from service 10's missing mapping.
August has no incidents. Keep EMPTY_COHORT_BLOCKED_NO_FINANCIAL_QUERY, never complete zero.

coverage.sourceExecution: Source formulas/home/grain/units are unchanged. Ordinary app catalog plus --data and generated catalog both apply manifest-bound diagnostics on actual filtered source rows. Receipts retain the diagnostic query/counts; partial known subsets cannot be complete answers.
coverage.liveSource: Required raw-source coverage has no reviewed live MCP contract. Those queries fail closed before source dispatch; transport complete/count alone is not coverage proof. No fallback or invented MCP fields.
coverage.siteTelemetry: Five-day observation window, days 14-18 of each service month. Incident intervals outside that window are separate source facts, not full-month telemetry proof.
coverage.care: Four observed snapshot dates per case.
coverage.inventory: Days 20-22 per month only; not full event-based stock accounting.
coverage.growth: August assignments and August 29 observed synthetic outcomes only.

compatibility.oldCli: Default hero remains smoke-only; showcase requires explicit opt-in and matching model/catalog census.
compatibility.historicalAssets: Do not rebuild or overwrite miniature fixtures, gold, P0/native/archived packet contents or historical receipt hashes.
compatibility.deployment: Packet staging is not deployment. P0 deployment helpers still accept only subscriptions/finance; no network deployment flag is introduced.
compatibility.counterfactual: No counterfactual simulator or subminute settlement claimed.

evidenceGaps: Independent review and parent acceptance pending.
DAX engine/TMDL parser, Direct Lake load, model refresh, native generation, MCP reader, paid inference and current cloud state are NOT_RUN.
No live/native proof is inferred from fixture executions or these source cases.
Full eight-model live stories, causal effect, RLS/OLS and benchmark campaigns are outside this task.
